summary: Implemented CLOSE-3: derived topic-status badge with text, icon, tone, and linked-note count on topic detail and the card list; notes and sources stay unbadged, statuses update in place after keyboard connection add/delete, and all required checks pass.

payload.agentOutputExcerpt: Implemented CLOSE-3: derived topic-status badge with text, icon, tone, and linked-note count on topic detail and the card list; notes and sources stay unbadged, statuses update in place after keyboard connection add/delete, and all required checks pass.
decisions: TopicStatusBadge accepts the readiness-derived status and count, never computes or stores them; call sites derive via deriveReadiness on each render.
The component itself returns null for notes and sources as a guard in addition to opt-in call-site rendering.
The badge uses a polite status role with an aria-label naming both status and count; it is non-interactive and skipped by Tab.
Replaced the old plain string-count topic line in the card list with the badge, preserving note/source string counts.
interfaces: linkedNoteCountLabel formatting: 0 linked notes / 1 linked note / N linked notes
CardListPanelProps.connections now feeds render-time readiness derivation
warnings: Only component tests were required; no Playwright journey was run for the badge task.
validationLimitations: Responsive visual behavior at 390x844/768x1024/1280x800 was not exercised in a real browser for this task; the CSS uses wrapping and tokens only, and the browser matrix remains with A11Y hardening.
payload.taskDescription: Create TopicStatusBadge with text, icon, and tone for Orphan, Developing, and Solved. Add it to topic detail and the card list, and show the linked-note count. Keep the badge out of notes and sources. Ensure the status is computed from readiness selectors at read time and updates after connection changes. Add component tests for all three states, zero/one/two notes, keyboard label text, and no score wording. Do not modify the Pixi card sprite.
